editorial.name: Northstar
editorial.descriptionZh: 面向雇主的员工财务健康福利项目官网：把 CFP 顾问的一对一咨询、理财工具和多媒体课程打包成一项公司统一采购的员工待遇。页面左上角标注 Northstar Powered by NAYYA。
editorial.takeawayZh: 给员工配一位 CFP 顾问，做一对一财务行动计划
editorial.noteZh: 首屏米白底，左边三行衬线大字 Personalized financial guidance for every employee，右边一张绿色几何剪影里的人像照片，浮着 Choose the right health plan 和 Save for childcare 两枚标签。导航是 How it works / Impact / Global / Resources / For consultants，右上角只有 Sign In 与 Sign Up，没有任何产品端入口。往下按 Advisors、Tools、Education 三块讲服务，Advisors 一项写明 unlimited 1-on-1 access to personal financial advisors (CFP®) over chat, phone, and video。Global 一节说 Available in 46 countries，并要求按当地法规和文化做定制。整页下半截被一个 Cookiebot 的同意面板压住，四个开关默认全开。
editorial.pricing: unknown（页面只有 Request a tour，未公开档位）

reasons.statement: 进来看到的是 Northstar 这个雇主福利项目的介绍页与 Request a tour 入口，导航分 How it works / Impact / Global / Resources，没有任何工具或素材可拿，按产品官网归入单站展示。

pages.title: Northstar: Financial Wellness Program for Employees
pages.selectionRationale: 本条目采集于 2026-09-15 的首屏实测；手记描述的就是这一屏。

shot.alt: Northstar 首屏：Personalized financial guidance for every employee

facts.value: 覆盖 46 个国家，各地按法规与文化定制
facts.evidence: 正文 Global 一节写 Available in 46 countries, Northstar offers the same 1-on-1 financial advisor access and product experience to employees around the world, customized for local regulations, culture, and benefits

facts.value: 每位员工配一位 Northstar Advisor (CFP®)，产出 step-by-step action plan
facts.evidence: 正文写 employees are paired with a Northstar Advisor (CFP®) who learns about their unique concerns and priorities, and builds them a custom, step-by-step action plan

facts.value: 页面自标 Powered by NAYYA
facts.evidence: 首屏左上角 logo 处写 Northstar 与 Powered by NAYYA 两行

facts.value: 同意管理用的是 Cookiebot（Usercentrics），四个开关 Necessary / Preferences / Statistics / Marketing
facts.evidence: 首屏弹出的 cookie 面板底部写着 Cookiebot by Usercentrics，并列出四个分类开关

cautions: 站点上未找到明确的许可声明，本条记录按 v3 规格记为 unknown；再分发或商用前必须自行确认。
